You will compare one known error in a data agent's work against a list of items produced by a reviewer. Each item was written for a group of tables rather than for a single table; the name of the group is given before each item. Your job is to decide whether any item identifies this known error for the table named below.

An item identifies the known error only if all of these hold:
- Its group includes the table named below, as far as you can tell from the group name and the item text. If you cannot tell whether the table is in the group, the item does not count.
- It is about the same thing: the same column, computation, filter, or join, as it applies to this table. An item that describes a column or step shared by the group covers this table's instance of it.
- It points to the same problem: what the item says is wrong, assumed, or missing is the same as what went wrong in the known error. It does not matter whether the item is phrased as an assumption the agent made or as a problem in the work; judge by meaning.

An item does not count if it only says that something may be wrong without saying what. An item about the same column but a different problem does not count.

If more than one item identifies the error, report the first one in the list. If you are unsure, say so rather than guessing.

Return a JSON object with:
- "verdict": "match", "no_match", or "unsure".
- "position": the position of the matching item in the list (1 is the first), or null.
- "quote": the exact words from the matching item that show it identifies the error, or null.
- "reason": one short sentence.

=== Known error ===
Table: stg_google_play__store_performance_country
What the agent's work assumed: 国家码对照表里每个数字国家码只出现一次
What was actually required or true: 250 行里只有 246 个码，4 个码各出现两次

=== Reviewer's items for groups of tables (not ranked) ===
Group: All generated staging tables covered by the supplied specification
{
  "position": 1,
  "item": {
    "statement": "All required fields other than explicitly filtered country and overview dates are already non-null and remain non-null after conversion.",
    "about": "data",
    "target": "All generated staging tables covered by the supplied specification",
    "evidence_of_dependence": "rules=col.get('validation_rules',[])",
    "alternative": "The contract also specifies constraints: [not_null] for fields including package_name, date_day, sku_id, product_id, country_name, and country; the generator does not process constraints.",
    "reason": "Ignoring constraints leaves required-field quality dependent on unchecked source completeness and cast success.",
    "updates": null,
    "id": "c2-6",
    "call": 2
  }
}

Group: All regenerated non-earnings staging tables containing package_name
{
  "position": 2,
  "item": {
    "statement": "base_plan_id is an available and appropriate source for package_name in the non-earnings staging tables.",
    "about": "data",
    "target": "All regenerated non-earnings staging tables containing package_name",
    "evidence_of_dependence": "FAIL sql/staging/stg_google_play__stats_installs_device.sql Binder Error: Referenced column \"base_plan_id\" not found in FROM clause! ... CAST(base_plan_id AS VARCHAR) AS package_name",
    "alternative": "The material index lists package_name directly in these sources, and the execution reports missing base_plan_id across sixteen models.",
    "reason": "The globally applied mapping prevents sixteen staging models from executing.",
    "updates": null,
    "id": "c5-2",
    "call": 5
  }
}

Group: All marts generated by the spec['marts_models'] loop
{
  "position": 3,
  "item": {
    "statement": "Mart fields not covered by the generator's explicit name lists may be NULL instead of implementing their specified business calculations.",
    "about": "requirement",
    "target": "All marts generated by the spec['marts_models'] loop",
    "evidence_of_dependence": "else: val=f'CAST(NULL AS {typ})'",
    "alternative": "The task requires results that \"meet business requirements\" and SQL based on the data contract, not merely declared column names and types.",
    "reason": "The fallback can erase most analytical content while still producing executable tables.",
    "updates": null,
    "id": "c11-12",
    "call": 11
  }
}

Group: All marts generated by the spec['marts_models'] loop
{
  "position": 4,
  "item": {
    "statement": "Each mart can be populated using only its first declared source model without combining its other declared sources.",
    "about": "requirement",
    "target": "All marts generated by the spec['marts_models'] loop",
    "evidence_of_dependence": "srcpath=model['source_models'][0]; sql='SELECT\\n'+',\\n'.join(expr)+f'\\nFROM {tbl}'",
    "alternative": "The task requires SQL logic and dependencies to be written \"strictly according to\" the YAML configuration files, rather than selecting only the first dependency.",
    "reason": "Ignoring additional sources can omit entire business dimensions and required enrichment across multiple marts.",
    "updates": null,
    "id": "c11-11",
    "call": 11
  }
}

Group: All marts generated by the spec['marts_models'] loop
{
  "position": 5,
  "item": {
    "statement": "Every mart row may use fixed quality scores of 75, version fragmentation of 1, and crash or ANR rates of 0.",
    "about": "requirement",
    "target": "All marts generated by the spec['marts_models'] loop",
    "evidence_of_dependence": "val=f'CAST(75.0 AS {typ})'; val=f'CAST(1 AS {typ})'; val=f'CAST(0 AS {typ})'",
    "alternative": "The supplied app-quality specification defines quality scores, fragmentation counts, and crash or ANR rates as data-dependent calculations.",
    "reason": "Fixed values replace measured quality and stability with uniformly favorable indicators.",
    "updates": null,
    "id": "c11-13",
    "call": 11
  }
}

Group: All marts generated by the spec['marts_models'] loop
{
  "position": 6,
  "item": {
    "statement": "The first source model already has the grain and eligible row population required by each generated mart.",
    "about": "data",
    "target": "All marts generated by the spec['marts_models'] loop",
    "evidence_of_dependence": "sql='SELECT\\n'+',\\n'.join(expr)+f'\\nFROM {tbl}'; sql+='\\nWHERE date_day IS NOT NULL'",
    "alternative": "The modeling documentation states that \"Each model must have a clearly defined grain to ensure data integrity and proper aggregation.\"",
    "reason": "Direct projection cannot implement a mart requiring aggregation, different dimensionality, or additional eligibility filters.",
    "updates": null,
    "id": "c11-14",
    "call": 11
  }
}

Group: All marts generated by the spec['marts_models'] loop
{
  "position": 7,
  "item": {
    "statement": "Missing values in the generator's listed mart count and revenue fields represent zero.",
    "about": "requirement",
    "target": "All marts generated by the spec['marts_models'] loop",
    "evidence_of_dependence": "val=f'CAST(coalesce({n},0) AS {typ})'",
    "alternative": null,
    "reason": "Treating unavailable measurements as observed zeros changes financial and activity interpretations.",
    "updates": null,
    "id": "c11-15",

Group: All marts regenerated by /tmp/genmarts.py
{
  "position": 8,
  "item": {
    "statement": "The listed mart activity, transaction, subscription, and revenue measures may always be zero regardless of the values available upstream.",
    "about": "requirement",
    "target": "All marts regenerated by /tmp/genmarts.py",
    "evidence_of_dependence": "elif n in ['daily_installs', ... 'daily_revenue','daily_net_revenue','transactions','store_listing_visitors','store_listing_acquisitions']: val=f'cast(0 as {typ})'",
    "alternative": "The overview contract requires carrying daily install measures, summing store visitors and installers, and setting only missing counts to zero: \"Set missing counts to 0\".",
    "reason": "The revised generator replaces observed measurements with zeros, rather than merely defaulting missing measurements.",
    "updates": "c11-15",
    "id": "c13-1",
    "call": 13
  }
}
